title: Judge leaks at the student's level
statement: Count an answer found without the text as a leak only when a typical student at the target level could find it the same way, not merely a strong model.
example: At one grade, dropping low-confidence forced guesses cut recoveries on 45 items from 43 to 39.
detail: A calibration on 45 live items found a strong solver recovered 43 without the text under the strict bar and 39 once low-confidence forced guesses were dropped, noting that a strong solver out-reads the child, and recommended counting a recovery as a leak only when a typical third grader could plausibly reproduce it (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g3-control-set-2026-07-10/G3-CALIBRATION-REPORT.md`). One run's blind-solver instructions set the bar at a savvy student, not an expert (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-expansion-session-2026-07-08-claude/run/SOLVER_V2.md`), and the retrospective of a parallel run called the grade-level bar the clearer one because it asks whether a real fifth grader could reproduce the recovery (`grade3-reading/artifacts/g5-expansion-session-2026-07-08-codex/QUESTION_GENERATION_RETROSPECTIVE_2026-07-08.md`).
against: An earlier protocol counted any model recovery, marking an item leaked at 2 of 3 correct recoveries (`grade3-reading/artifacts/LANE3_LLM.md`), and a unit report pulled an item from serving once a newer solver answered it 3 of 3 without the text (`grade3-reading/artifacts/demo-unit-2026-07-10/phase-d/DELTA-REPORT.md`).

Gate bars were split across tranches. The 700 MATCH items used `loosened`; the 167 non-match items used `grade5`. Both bars were trying to avoid requiring frontier-model-proof questions for fifth graders, but `grade5` is the clearer default going forward because it asks whether the blind recovery is realistically student-reproducible.
A strong solver out-reads a third grader by an even wider margin than it out-reads a fifth grader, so raw blind-solve success is the wrong yardstick at G3.
- Text-dependence ablation uses a language model, which may have different knowledge than a typical G3–G5 student. Items that fail for LLMs may be valid for students (false positives) or vice versa.
